title.narrative: Data Exchange Platform Study (TA to e-Governance Board of Nepal)

description.narrative: This project - Data Exchange Platform Study- is a Technical Assistance (TA) to e-Governance Board of Nepal. The board established as the apex body for digital transformation of Government of Nepal’s public service delivery, system and processes is implementing a national data interoperability system. This represents a cornerstone in Nepal’s digital transformation journey, which will revolutionise how individuals and agencies (public and private) exchange data and deliver services to citizens. This initiative aligns with Nepal's commitment to the Digital Nepal Framework 2.0 and the broader vision of inclusive and efficient governance through digital means. This project is aimed to pave the way for implementing a solution that will establish a sustainable framework to support future digital governance initiatives in Nepal.
